{{Quote|Lord Goh prefers to speak through actions rather than words. In that regard, he's a flawless communicator.|[[Lana Beniko]], referring to Goh's communication skills|<ref name="FAI" />}}
'''Lord Goh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3637 BBY]] Goh became a member of the [[Order of Revan]] and joined a fellow Revanite [[Darth Arkous]] in planning and executing the [[Assault on Tython|attack]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The initial strike was a success, allowing Goh to search the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] artifact for Arkous. However, Goh was soon afterwards killed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team sent to retake Tython.<ref name="FAI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Goh first appeared in game update 2.7 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2014]]. Goh is part of the "Shadow of Revan prelude" storyline that was released throughout 2014 under the name of "Forged Alliances". He never speaks except during the fight in the Assault on Tython Flashpoint, where he yells words such as "Suffer!", "Worm..." "Scum...".
